inputs.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, cover page
inputs.quote: As of February 10, 2025, there were 2,248,950,826 shares of the registrants' Class A common stock outstanding, 95,400,680 shares of the registrant's Class B common stock outstanding, and 1,005,000 shares of the registrant's Class F common stock outstanding.

inputs.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, share class rights
inputs.quote: The rights, including the liquidation and dividend rights, of the holders of Class A, Class B, and Class F common stock (collectively, the "common stock") are identical, except with respect to voting and conversion.

source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Item 5
source.quote: As of February 10, 2025, there were 1,678 holders of record of our Class A common stock, 22 holders of record of our Class B common stock, and one holder of record of our Class F common stock.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's row in NBIM's year-end 2024 holdings data file ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); the same line in NBIM's equity CSV download (https://www.nbim.no/api/investments/v2/report/?assetType=eq&date=2024-12-31&fileType=csv) reads "North America;United States;Palantir Technologies Inc;Technology;19636518496;1728970094;0.73%;1%". CalPERS: the source is CalPERS's 13F-HR/A (restatement) for the quarter ended December 31, 2024, filed April 23, 2025; its information table is identical to the original 13F-HR filed February 12, 2025. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. CalPERS: CalPERS holds Class A; denominator is Classes A, B and F, which the 10-K says have identical liquidation and dividend rights. Holders of record: Listed Class A only; the 10-K also gives 22 holders of record of Class B and one of Class F.
